# Master-key baseline: the sample campaign on commit 0f2f9d02, lore and session both read

Made with `graph_key_check BACKUP --docs both` (and `--docs lore` for the earlier file,
[run_2026-11-06_lore_0f2f9d02.md](run_2026-11-06_lore_0f2f9d02.md)) on the owner's backup of the public sample campaign,
exported 2026-11-06 after the session was read. Same deployed commit (0f2f9d02) as the lore baseline, so what changed
between the two files is the session read. Sample names are public, so they are printed; nothing here is from a
player's own words beyond the public sample.

## At a glance (master key, this backup)

| | In the key | Found | Waiting | Wrong type | Missing (must-find) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Entries** | 95 | **69** | 0 | 0 | 24 (24) |
| **Ties** | 133 | **43** | 0 | 12 | 78 (52) |

Entries left out by design (after #3630): Yeti and Mind flayer absent; Ice troll was made anyway (found). Extra entries not
in the key: 11. Extra ties between key entries: 33. Player characters found: 4 of 4. Events 2 of 4 expected.
**Must-not-find names present: 2** (below). Feelings scored (#3606, `graph_key_check` on #3606's branch): 5, exact 4,
over-read 1 (m081, Belleros to Brewner, still held as hostile; the key says wary), under-read 0.

The 2026-11-04 report is not directly comparable: its key had 100 entries and 134 ties and the key has changed since
(creatures marked by design, groups and items added). On this key: entries 69 of 95 (73 percent), ties 43 of 133
(32 percent), against the lore-only baseline of 64 of 89 and 41 of 119: the session added 5 entries and 2 ties
that the key expects; most of what the session says that the key lists is still missing or the wrong kind.

## What the session read made that it must not (the new finding)

Every entry below has source `extractor` (the session reader) and status confirmed (the DM accepted it):
- **"an owlbear" (character) and "owlbears" (group):** a kind of creature the rules hold; the key says no entry (#3373 rule,
  and "Owlbears" is a must-not-find name). The lore path already drops these (`in_the_rules`); the session path does not.
- **"maul barbarian" (character):** one of "the attackers", an unnamed person described by their weapon (key rule 3, #3244).
  "barbarians" and "morningstar barbarian" from the 2026-11-04 run are gone, so part of that was fixed; this one was not.
- Names that are descriptions or have an article or brackets: "Valyra's sibling (either Ok or Nysarra)", "brewner's human
  daughter", "Okthandom's child (no name given yet)", "Minotaur captain" (the key's "The minotaur captain" exists as a
  tie end, not found by this spelling), "unknown patron", "Keegan Velryn's home", "jimbo" (lowercase; may be a real name).
Filed as its own issue (see the PR that adds this file).

Must-find ties missing 44 (lore alone 42): new misses are the session's own ties (m120 Lantern of Greater Tracking carried
by Okthandom, m121 Garret's old sled, m123 the kennel, m126 Jebidiah and Keegan, m127 Claude knows (friendly) Okthandom,
m133 the party last seen at the windbreak shelter). Wrong type 8: the party works_for Speaker Masthew and Keegan Velryn
(m076, m118) and Belleros knows Claude (m091) join the lore's m012, m037, m041, m107, m108.
Unchanged from the lore baseline: every sacrifice tie, the Ten-Towns places, the characters' mutual knows ties,
the special items without an entry, the party's members.
